name: Nela Riehl - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the European Semester for economic policy coordination: employment and social priorities – annual report 2026
part_text:
Parliament sets out its wish list for the 2026 European Semester, the yearly round in which the European Union coordinates national budgets and policies. It asks for social goals to count as much as economic ones: less poverty, especially among children, better minimum income support, affordable housing, and training rights for workers. It is an opinion, not a law. Most of what it asks for depends on the European Commission and member states acting on it.

- **What changes:** nothing yet; Parliament asks the Commission and member states to act.
- **Who it affects:** people at risk of poverty, children, disabled people, workers needing training, tenants.
- **What happens next:** the Commission and member states decide whether to follow these requests.
